endpoints.truth_yaml:
post:
  operationId: resubmitEntriesForUserApproval
  summary: Resubmit another user's entries for approval
  x-verification-status: UNCONFIRMED-AGREE
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-020000-post.workspaces.approval-requests.users.resubmit-entries-for-approval-path-existence.json
  x-notes: |
    GET probe returns 405 confirming path is registered in Clockify routing. Raw writes
    disabled so POST could not be tested directly. The MCP tool clockify_approvals_resubmit
    uses the non-user-scoped sibling path (LIVE-VERIFIED in iter17). The user-scoped path
    is handled internally by resubmitForUserApproval → postUserApprovalPeriod with parts
    [approval-requests, users, {userId}, resubmit-entries-for-approval]. No separate exported
    MCP tool exposes this path; 405 path registration is the best available live evidence.
  x-truth-iter: iter18
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
    - name: userId
      in: path
      required: true
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          required:
            - approval_id
            - entry_ids
            - period
            - period_start
          properties:
            approval_id:
              type: string
              description: Approval request ID
            entry_ids:
              type: array
              items:
                type: string
              description: Time entry IDs to resubmit
            expense_ids:
              type: array
              items:
                type: string
              description: Expense IDs to resubmit
            period:
              type: string
              enum: [WEEKLY, SEMI_MONTHLY, MONTHLY]
            period_start:
              type: string
              format: date-time
            note:
              type: string
              maxLength: 500
  responses:
    '400':
      description: Business logic error (no active approval request for period, or approval already approved)
    '200':
      description: Resubmit successful — approval object returned
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            description: Approval request object (same shape as submit response)
endpoints.notes: Both specs agree on this path. GET probe returns 405 confirming path is registered (Spring-MVC: wrong method, not absent). Raw writes are disabled so we cannot do a live POST. The MCP tool clockify_approvals_resubmit (non-user path sibling) returned a biz-logic 400 in a parallel call confirming the approval approval system is live. The user-scoped path follows the same pattern. Status UNCONFIRMED-AGREE: path is registered, specs agree, but no live POST biz-logic response captured for this exact user-scoped variant.

endpoints.truth_yaml:
post:
  operationId: searchAuditLog
  summary: Search workspace audit log entries
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-020000-post.workspaces.audit-log-happy-path.json
  x-notes: |
    Tool clockify_audit_logs_search returned 7 CREATE_PROJECT entries successfully.
    Server ignores page_size — all matching rows up to server cap are returned regardless.
    content field is a stringified JSON string, not a nested object.
    previousContent is nullable (null when no previous state, e.g. on CREATE actions).
  x-truth-iter: iter18
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          required:
            - actions
            - author_ids
            - start
            - end
          properties:
            actions:
              type: array
              items:
                type: string
              description: Audit-log action type filter
            author_ids:
              type: array
              items:
                type: string
              description: User IDs to filter by (use SYSTEM for system actions)
            start:
              type: string
              format: date-time
            end:
              type: string
              format: date-time
            page:
              type: integer
              minimum: 1
            page_size:
              type: integer
              description: Requested page size; server ignores and applies own cap
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Audit log entries matching filters
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: array
            items:
              type: object
              properties:
                action:
                  type: string
                  description: Action enum (e.g. CREATE_PROJECT, DELETE_TIME_PERSONAL)
                content:
                  type: string
                  description: Stringified JSON of the new entity state
                previousContent:
                  type: string
                  nullable: true
                  description: Stringified JSON of prior state; null on CREATE actions
                timestamp:
                  type: string
                  format: date-time
                userEmail:
                  type: string
                userId:
                  type: string
                userName:
                  type: string
                workspaceId:
                  type: string
endpoints.notes: LIVE-VERIFIED: clockify_audit_logs_search returned 7 audit entries with full response shape observed. Key finding: server ignores page_size (returns all matching rows up to server cap). content field is a stringified JSON object, not a nested object. previousContent is null on CREATE actions. Timestamp is RFC3339.

endpoints.truth_yaml:
post:
  operationId: createExpense
  summary: Create an expense in the workspace
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-020000-post.workspaces.expenses-dry-run.json
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-001500-delete.workspaces.expenses-happy-path.json
  x-notes: |
    dry_run confirmed payload construction: amount (major units default, coerced to string
    upstream), categoryId (required), date (RFC3339), userId (defaults to caller).
    project_id is optional — dry_run succeeded without it. Prior iter confirmed actual
    expense creation and deletion via delete.workspaces.expenses probe (expense id
    <redacted-id:78b0838c43>). amount sent as string upstream despite number input.
  x-truth-iter: iter18
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          required:
            - amount
            - date
            - category_id
          properties:
            amount:
              type: number
              description: Expense amount in major currency units by default
            amount_unit:
              type: string
              enum: [major, minor]
              default: major
            date:
              type: string
              format: date-time
            category_id:
              type: string
              description: Expense category ID (required)
            project_id:
              type: string
              description: Optional project
            task_id:
              type: string
            user_id:
              type: string
              description: Defaults to calling user
            billable:
              type: boolean
            notes:
              type: string
              maxLength: 2000
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Expense created
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            description: Expense object with id, workspaceId, categoryId, amount, date, userId, billable, notes
endpoints.notes: LIVE-VERIFIED: dry_run confirmed tool routing and payload construction for POST /workspaces/{wId}/expenses. Prior iter's delete probe confirms an actual expense was created and deleted. category_id is required; project_id is optional. amount is coerced to string in the upstream payload. userId defaults to the calling user. No discrepancies with spec.
